# Preview freezes when opened

## Outcome

Readers can reopen previews.

## Actual

The preview freezes after printing the report label.

```text
Related: Preview notes
Related work: Archived notes
```

## Reproduction

1. Open report.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: Preview responds.
